results.snippet:
The Arctic is Europe's Northern Neighbourhood. It is close, connected and critical to our future.

Three EU Member States – Denmark, Finland and Sweden – are Arctic nations. More than half a million EU citizens live there.

All this makes Arctic security European security. To defend our interests, we plan to step up investments in surveillance, infrastructure, military mobility, and capabilities.
